# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v2.0.x+ | :white_check_mark: |
| < v2.0  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.
Please report security issues by emailing `security@xgenia.com` or by using GitHub's "Report a Vulnerability" feature in the Security tab. We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours.
